openItems.id: Unsigned Change Order Left Out · BIL-2, BIL-1
openItems.explanation: CO-04, exterior signage, $14,500.00, is on the project manager's progress at $5,800.00 but the owner has not signed it. The change order log shows CO-04 submitted November 12, 2026 and “pending owner signature”. The contract and BIL-2 admit only change orders the owner has signed, so application 7 leaves the line out: its $14,500.00 is not in the contract sum to date and its $5,800.00 of work is not billed. Once the owner signs, the work goes on the next application. Left in, the owner's architect would have returned the whole application.

$18,600.00 of fixtures stored off site at Northline Bonded Storage, unit 14 is on the progress without a certificate of insurance or the owner's approval. The project manager lists $18,600.00 of materials stored on line 5, electrical and lighting: pendant and linear LED fixtures, reading room and stacks (42 units). Lumenfield's bill of sale BOS-2207 supports the value, but it has no attachments: the contract and BIL-4 also require a certificate of insurance covering the storage location and naming Bellhaven Library District, and the owner's written approval. Application 7 holds the materials back, which lowers the current payment due by $17,670.00 after retainage. With the certificate and the approval they can go on a supplemental application or on application 8.

openItems.id: Retainage Reduction Not in the Billing System · BIL-5
openItems.explanation: The billing system still withholds 10% on job S-2604; the owner approved 5% from application 7 on November 14, 2026. The contract lets the owner reduce retainage to 5% of the work completed and stored once the work is more than 50% complete. Application 6 brought it to 81%, and the owner's letter of November 14, 2026 approves 5% from application 7. At the system's 10%, retainage would be $37,000.00 and the current payment due $51,840.00. At 5% it is $18,500.00 and the payment due $70,340.00: $15,620.00 of the $31,240.00 held on earlier work is released and the new work carries 5%. Update the job's retainage rate in the billing system before the invoice is issued.

The draft unconditional waiver for Marlowe Ridge Dental PLLC releases application 6, $58,320.00, which has not been paid. An unconditional waiver gives up the right to be paid for the amount it names as soon as it is signed, so BIL-6 allows one only for money received. Application 6 (INV-3401, $58,320.00, billed October 15, 2026) is still open on the receivables ledger. The last payment received is application 5 (INV-3385), $41,760.00 on November 6, 2026, for work through September 30, 2026: the package carries the unconditional waiver for that payment instead, and application 6 gets its unconditional waiver when its payment arrives.
